2026-11-27.title: Fourth Friday of the Dedication of the Church
2026-11-27.readTitle: Readings of the day (Syro-Malabar Liturgical Calendar)
readings: A great multitude worships before the throne
He is God not of the dead, but of the living
2026-11-27.verse: He is God not of the dead, but of the living.
theo: The Sadducees, who denied the resurrection, try to ridicule it with the story of a woman married to seven brothers. Jesus answers that they know “neither the scriptures nor the power of God.” In the resurrection life is transformed; and God is “the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob”: “He is God not of the dead, but of the living.”

John sees the fulfilment: “a great multitude that no one could count, from every nation, from all tribes and peoples and languages,” robed in white with palm branches, crying: “Salvation belongs to our God… and to the Lamb!” On the last Friday of the year we look at the end of the story: the Church gathered in praise.
outline: Ask: do you really believe in the resurrection of the body?
Our hope rests on God's power, not our imagination.
Those who belong to God live in him.
The Church's end is worship before the Lamb.
“Salvation belongs to our God and to the Lamb.”
live: Pray the Creed slowly, pausing at “the resurrection of the body”.
Pray today for Christians of another nation or language.
2026-11-27.prayer: God of the living, you are the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. Strengthen our faith in the resurrection and gather us with the great multitude to praise you and the Lamb for ever. Amen.

quick: God is God of the living.
The resurrection rests on the power of God.
The Church's end: a multitude praising the Lamb.
2026-11-27.action: Pray for Christians of another nation today.
2026-11-27.question: Does my hope in the resurrection shape my daily life?

homily: Dear friends, the Sadducees, who denied the resurrection, try to ridicule it with the story of a woman married to seven brothers. Jesus answers that they are wrong because they know neither the scriptures nor the power of God. In the resurrection life is transformed; and God is the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob; he is God not of the dead but of the living (Mark 12:24–27).

The Book of Revelation shows us those living ones: a great multitude that no one could count, from every nation, tribe, people and language, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, robed in white, with palm branches in their hands, crying out: salvation belongs to our God and to the Lamb (Revelation 7:9–10).
In that multitude are our beloved dead, and generations of St Thomas Christians. Let us remember them today before the God of the living, and prepare our lives to join them in eternal praise. Amen.
kids: Children, in heaven people from every country praise God together. Pray today for your grandparents or others who have died.

intro: Jesus defends the resurrection; John sees the great multitude before the Lamb.

points.h: The God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob
sub: God revealed himself to Moses by the names of the patriarchs.
q: He said further, “I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.” And Moses hid his face, for he was afraid to look at God.

And as for the dead being raised, have you not read in the book of Moses, in the story about the bush, how God said to him, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? He is God not of the dead, but of the living.
points.apply: Pray for your ancestors in faith.

sub: The Church is catholic: every tribe and language.
Salvation belongs to God and the Lamb.
q: In days to come… all the nations shall stream to it.

After this I looked, and there was a great multitude that no one could count, from every nation, from all tribes and peoples and languages, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, robed in white, with palm branches in their hands.
points.apply: Pray for Christians of another nation today.

q: For from the rising of the sun to its setting my name is great among the nations.
Singing, “Amen! Blessing and glory and wisdom and thanksgiving and honor and power and might be to our God forever and ever! Amen.”
points.apply: Sing a hymn of praise at family prayer tonight.

concl: God is the God of the living; our hope is the resurrection.
The Church's end is eternal praise.
2026-11-27.resolve: Pray the Creed slowly each day this week.
